channel.title: Robotics Directory - Humanoid Robots
channel.description: Browse 390 humanoid robots in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: BYD Xiao Di
item.description: BYD's first humanoid robot, unveiled in August 2026 at its Di Space experience centres in Zhengzhou. Stands 1.61 m tall, weighs 58.5 kg with 31 degrees of freedom and 360-degree vision. Translates in real time between six Chinese dialects and six foreign languages. Designed for showroom service — greeting customers, explaining vehicle features and performing live demonstrations — with plans for 2-3 units per BYD dealership worldwide.

item.title: LimX Dynamics Luna
item.description: Full-size interactive humanoid robot (160 cm, 27 DoF) designed for commercial performance scenarios such as shopping malls, tourist attractions, trade shows and entertainment venues. Powered by LimX's second-generation Sys 0 engine with upgraded joint motors and thermal management; offers multi-modal interaction, millisecond-precise swarm control of 200+ units and an AI task editor for natural-language scene creation.

item.title: DroidUp Moya
item.description: Shanghai DroidUp's fully bionic android with a highly realistic body and natural human-robot interaction, showcased at WAIC 2026 and the 2026 Davos tech summit as a host, MC and performer for cultural, public-service and entertainment scenarios.

item.title: ROBROS IGRIS-C
item.description: Compact full-stack Korean humanoid (hardware, control and AI developed in-house): 43 DoF including 7-DoF arms and ~300 g tendon-driven five-finger hands with 6 active DoF each. RL-trained locomotion (walking, running, backflips) plus imitation-learning manipulation; Jetson Orin NX + Core i7. CES 2026 debut; pilots at Lotte Global Logistics and shipyards, units at Korean universities.

item.title: Liaode Technology E1 Yiyi
item.description: Ultra-realistic full-size walking companion robot with AI large-model conversation (multiple languages and dialects), emotion recognition, long-term memory and zero-code motion teaching for gestures such as waving, handshakes and hugs. Bipedal walking with stable turns and backward motion; 12-DoF bionic smart head; height customizable. Shown at WAIC 2026.

item.title: Dinghuo Bionic Technology Xiaomei
item.description: Ultra-realistic stationary bionic companion android from the WSG Doll brand (Dongguan Dinghuo Bionic Technology), developed with the Foshan-based Huanitech team of Jiaotong University researchers. Silicone skin over synthetic facial-muscle tethers, HD camera eyes with tracking, real-time lip sync, surface warmed to 36.5 °C, near-silent stepper motors. Build-to-order; fully articulated AI versions above 40000 USD.

item.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas
item.description: The current production Atlas is the electric enterprise humanoid announced January 5, 2026, distinct from the retired hydraulic Atlas and April 2024 electric development platform. Its October 15, 2026 datasheet specifies 1.9 m height, 90 kg, 56 DOF and IP67. Capacity is 50 kg instant, 30 kg sustained or 20 kg one-handed. Typical endurance is four hours, or two hours with heavy lifting; a three-minute autonomous battery swap is distinct from 1.5-hour charging. The 2.3 m reach has general workspace scope rather than an established arm-link length.

item.title: Mirsee Robotics MH3
item.description: 31 DOF, teleoperation VR, wireless charging, aluminum 6061

item.title: Noetix Robotics Xiaoyue
item.description: Newest Noetix humanoid debuted at WAIC 2026 (July 2026), positioned for cultural exhibitions, commercial engagement, brand experiences and IP collaborations. Detailed specs not yet publicly disclosed.

item.title: UniX AI Wanda 2.0
item.description: Mass-produced wheeled service humanoid, 23 DOF, 8-DOF bionic arms, grippers, tactile AI

item.title: Fauna Robotics Sprout
item.description: Soft 107 cm humanoid developer platform with 29 DOF, 6-DOF arms, 5-DOF legs, 1-DOF grippers, ZED 2i stereo vision, ToF sensors and Jetson AGX Orin.

item.title: Agilink OmniHand 3 Ultra-M
item.description: Human-scale 20-DOF direct-drive dexterous robotic hand with vision-based tactile fingertips for contact-rich manipulation and deformable-object handling.

item.title: Kawada Robotics NEXTAGE Fillie
item.description: Compact dual-arm collaborative humanoid for Japanese factory assembly tasks.

item.title: Generative Bionics GENE.01
item.description: Italian Physical AI humanoid platform with whole-body smart skin sensing touch, temperature, proximity and force, so it anticipates people before contact; tasks taught by physically guiding its arms. IIT spin-out (2024) building an EU actuation stack with Synapticon; 81M USD seed led by CDP Venture Capital; first use case a welding humanoid for Fincantieri shipyards; robot model open-sourced. Unveiled at AMD Advancing AI 2026.

item.title: Persona AI Persona Industrial Humanoid
item.description: Houston heavy-duty humanoid for shipyard welding and industrial work.

item.title: LG Electronics CLOiD
item.description: Wheeled five-fingered home humanoid for cooking, laundry and chores.

item.title: X-Humanoid Tien Kung 3.0
item.description: Beijing full-size humanoid with touch-interactive whole-body motion control.

item.title: Faraday Future FF Futurist
item.description: Full-size professional embodied-AI humanoid with a hot-swappable battery and optional 6-DoF dexterous hand.

item.title: Faraday Future FF Master
item.description: Compact athletic embodied-AI humanoid; price and specifications describe the Master Edu configuration.

item.title: Faraday Future All-New Futurist
item.description: Full-size humanoid with 31 DoF, 320 N·m peak knee torque, a 1,152 Wh dual-battery system and native NVIDIA SONIC support.

item.title: Genesis AI Eno
item.description: General-purpose humanoid worker with a wheeled base and an articulated tower that adjusts its height and reach in real time, folding down to checked-bag size for storage. Two arms with proprietary human-like dexterous hands and twenty active back-drivable degrees of freedom, driven by Genesis AI's GENE foundation model for long-horizon, millimeter-precision manipulation. First deployments target industrial, logistics and lab customers by the end of 2026.

item.title: IONO Robotics WORKMATE
item.description: Austria's humanoid robot for real work environments; features an integrated launchable drone in the head module and the IONOSPHERE control ecosystem.

item.title: Weave Robotics Isaac 1
item.description: Mobile dual-arm home assistant that folds laundry, tidies rooms, and makes beds.

item.title: UBTECH UWORLD U1 Pro
item.description: High-performance full-body edition of the ultra-bionic UWORLD U1 companion series.

item.title: UBTECH UWORLD U1 Ultra
item.description: High-dynamic full-body flagship of UBTECH's UWORLD U1 ultra-bionic humanoid line, with 88 DoF and a dual-pivot biomimetic cervical spine.

item.title: UBTECH UWORLD U1 Lite
item.description: Semi-torso entry edition of UBTECH's mass-produced UWORLD U1 ultra-bionic companion series.

item.title: MagicLab MagicBot X1
item.description: MagicLab humanoid platform identified as MagicBot X1 in the video coverage; detailed public specifications were not available.

item.title: Jiangsu Yunmu Intelligent Manufacturing YMBot E3
item.description: Educational humanoid robot from Yunmu's YMBot line, presented at WAIC 2026.

item.title: Jiangsu Yunmu Intelligent Manufacturing YMBot D4
item.description: Heavy-load industrial humanoid from Yunmu's YMBot line for embodied warehouse and factory work.

item.title: Galbot Galbot G1
item.description: Mobile dual-arm humanoid manipulator for home retail healthcare and industrial tasks.

item.title: Galbot Galbot S1
item.description: Galbot humanoid platform listed alongside G1 at WAIC 2026; detailed public specifications were not available.

item.title: DexForce DexForce W1
item.description: Full-body wheeled humanoid development platform with dual seven-DOF arms and autonomous mobile navigation.

item.title: JAKA Robotics JAKA π
item.description: Child-sized humanoid for retail, interaction and motion-capture applications.

item.title: JAKA Robotics JAKA Kargo
item.description: Autonomous wheeled humanoid for factory logistics and material handling.

item.title: AGIBOT A3 Ultra
item.description: A3 Ultra is a 174 cm, 60 kg commercial humanoid announced at WAIC on July 18, 2026. Its model announcement specifies 51 active DOF, five-kilogram payload per arm and up to eight hours combined operation. The brochure describes UWB/RTK positioning, LiDAR/camera sensing, autonomous plug-in charging and ten-second battery swapping. A3 base specifications of 55 kg and ten hours do not transfer to Ultra.

item.title: AGIBOT G2 Max
item.description: G2 Max is a heavy-duty force-controlled industrial robot announced at WAIC in July 2026 and formally launched on October 29, 2026. The latter release specifies 21 DOF, up to 40 kg dual-arm handling capacity and an adjustable working height of 0.1–2.5 m. Omnidirectional wheeled mobility supports handling and pallet-related applications. Combined load is not a per-arm rating; whole-body mass, battery endurance and charge duration remain unestablished.

item.title: Knowin KNOWIN-X1
item.description: Foldable dual-arm home robot from Shenzhen startup Knowin; Chinese reports describe a WAIC 2026 debut and a folded height under 40 cm for domestic assistance tasks.

item.title: Spirit AI Moz2
item.description: Commercial service robot from Spirit AI / Qianxun Intelligence, unveiled around WAIC 2026 with 32 DoF, omnidirectional wheeled base, foldable legs and a three-finger dexterous hand for stores, hotels and offices.

item.title: Genisom AI Yinyi NE01
item.description: Humanoid robot introduced by Genisom AI / Zhishen Technology at WAIC 2026 as a new embodied-intelligence platform alongside the company's quadruped line.

item.title: MagicLab MagicBot D1
item.description: Industrial wheeled humanoid shown by MagicLab at WAIC 2026 as part of its new product lineup with MagicBot X1 and MagicDog T1.

item.title: Dobot LUMO
item.description: DOBOT's LUMO, unveiled August 2026, is billed as the world's first 'embodied all-terrain' humanoid. Standing nearly 1.3 m tall, it walks across lawn, sand and cobblestone with an anthropomorphic gait, boxes, dances and performs backflips. Powered by DOBOT's self-developed Kongyi embodied large model, it fuses vision, voice and motion for multimodal emotion perception, 3D spatial understanding and autonomous learning that adapts over time. Designed as a home companion, sports playmate and popular-science partner for everyday users, and as a secondary-development platform for K12, vocational and research users.

item.title: Zeroth M1
item.description: Embodied intelligence home companion robot with 20 DoF, dual arms, bipedal and wheeled mobility modes. LDS LiDAR whole-home mapping, iTOF depth sensing, vision camera, IMU and 3-mic array with 16-foot pickup. Fall detection, safety checks, daily assistance, scam prevention, pet monitoring and remote interaction. Open multi-language programming platform with VR integration and reinforcement learning tools. Fast charging 80% in 1 hour.

item.title: Zeroth Jupiter
item.description: Compact full-size humanoid robot for versatile real-world applications. Supports both teleoperation and autonomous modes, adapting to different task requirements. Designed for training, simulation and front-of-house service with intelligent interaction and operational capabilities for real-world human environments.

item.title: Unitree GD01
item.description: World's first mass-produced transformable mecha. Manned bipedal-to-quadruped machine with a torso-mounted cockpit for a pilot. Transitions between bipedal walking and four-legged crawl mode. 500 kg total weight with pilot, high-strength alloy construction. Starting price 3.9 million yuan.

item.title: Unitree Modular Humanoid
item.description: Low-cost modular humanoid starting at $4,290 with 31 degrees of freedom and flexible deployment. Quietly launched alongside Unitree's Shanghai IPO pricing in August 2026.

item.title: Walden Robotics General-Purpose Robot
item.description: Full-stack Physical AI company spun out of Toyota Research Institute in January 2026. Builds general-purpose robots powered by Large Behavior Models (LBMs) and Diffusion Policy. Deployed in production at a Toyota plant since February 2026 doing machine tending, tool setting, parts kitting and assembly. $300M seed at $1.1B valuation co-led by Toyota and Deviation Capital with NVIDIA, Boeing and Samsung Ventures.

item.title: Sharpa North
item.description: 67-DoF full-body humanoid from Singapore-based Sharpa (founded by Hesai Technology co-founders). SharpaWave dexterous hands with 22 active DoF and 1000+ tactile pixels per fingertip. <0.02s hand reaction time, ~2mm finger positioning precision. CraftNet VTLA neural model (Vision, Tactile, Language, Action). At CES 2026: autonomous ping-pong rallies, 30+ step windmill assembly, card dealing, photography. 4 consecutive days, 8h/day fully autonomous demos.

item.title: Lanxin Robotics VB2
item.description: Wheeled humanoid from Lanxin Robotics. 170 cm tall with 7-joint dual arms, 5 kg grip per arm, 4-wheel omnidirectional base. 3D laser SLAM navigation. CES 2026 sequel to VersaBot VB-1 with extended runtime and improved manipulation. Research and industrial automation platform.

item.title: LG Electronics KAPEX
item.description: South Korean bipedal humanoid from LG Electronics. General-purpose platform for commercial service applications. In development stage, targeting hospitality and retail scenarios.

item.title: AGIBOT A3
item.description: A3 is the full-size 173 cm, 55 kg performance humanoid launched in 2026. The manufacturer brochure lists a dual-battery configuration labelled 1152 Wh, up-to-ten-hour endurance, hot swapping and fleet choreography for over 100 robots. UWB positioning and LinkCraft motion creation support coordinated performances. Whole-body DOF, exact arm payload and charging duration are not established by the selected text.
